english.title: Holder of full large goods vehicle licence being under 21 years of age fail to comply with condition of that licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person under the age of 21 and the holder of a full large goods vehicle drivers licence, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the prescribed conditions in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 114(1)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
